<document id="atm-network">
FindingˆaˆBrookLinkˆATMˆBrookLinkˆisˆourˆATMˆnetwork.ˆWithdrawalsˆatˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆareˆfreeˆonˆeveryˆplanˆ($0.00ˆfromˆus,ˆandˆtheˆATMˆownerˆdoesn'tˆaddˆaˆsurcharge).ˆ##ˆFindˆaˆBrookLinkˆATMˆOpenˆtheˆapp,ˆtapˆCash,ˆthenˆATMˆmap.ˆTheˆmapˆshowsˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆnearˆyouˆwithˆopeningˆhours,ˆsinceˆsomeˆareˆinsideˆstores.ˆ##ˆUsingˆotherˆATMsˆYouˆcanˆuseˆanyˆATMˆthatˆacceptsˆVisa.ˆOutsideˆBrookLink,ˆyouˆmayˆpayˆanˆout-of-networkˆfeeˆdependingˆonˆyourˆplan,ˆandˆtheˆATMˆownerˆmayˆaddˆaˆsurcharge.ˆTheˆATMˆscreenˆshouldˆshowˆtheˆowner'sˆsurchargeˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm.ˆ##ˆDailyˆlimitsˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆcountˆtowardˆaˆdailyˆATMˆlimitˆthatˆdependsˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆSeeˆ"ATMˆwithdrawalˆlimits".ˆ##ˆDepositingˆcashˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆdon'tˆtakeˆcashˆdeposits.ˆToˆaddˆcash,ˆuseˆaˆparticipatingˆretailˆstoreˆinstead.ˆSeeˆ"Depositingˆcashˆatˆaˆstore".ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="atm-fees-basic-v2">
ATMˆfeesˆonˆBasicˆHere'sˆwhatˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆcostˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan.ˆ|ˆATMˆ|ˆTallowbrookˆfeeˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBrookLink,ˆinˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆAnyˆotherˆATMˆinˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆ$2.50ˆ|ˆ|ˆATMsˆoutsideˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆEveryˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawalˆisˆchargedˆtheˆfee.ˆToˆavoidˆit,ˆuseˆaˆBrookLinkˆATM.ˆ##ˆSurchargesˆATMˆownersˆoutsideˆBrookLinkˆcanˆaddˆtheirˆownˆsurchargeˆonˆtopˆofˆourˆfee.ˆTheˆATMˆshowsˆitˆonˆscreenˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm.ˆ##ˆDailyˆlimitˆYouˆcanˆwithdrawˆupˆtoˆ$500ˆaˆdayˆonˆBasic.ˆ##ˆWhereˆfeesˆshowˆupˆAnyˆTallowbrookˆATMˆfeeˆappearsˆasˆitsˆownˆlineˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆrightˆafterˆtheˆwithdrawal,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆwhatˆyouˆpaidˆusˆandˆwhatˆtheˆATMˆownerˆcharged.ˆTheˆapp'sˆATMˆmapˆshowsˆtheˆnearestˆBrookLinkˆATMs.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="atm-fees-premium">
ATMˆfeesˆonˆPremiumˆHere'sˆwhatˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆcostˆonˆtheˆPremiumˆplan.ˆ|ˆATMˆ|ˆTallowbrookˆfeeˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBrookLink,ˆinˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆAnyˆotherˆATMˆinˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆnoˆfeeˆ|ˆ|ˆATMsˆoutsideˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆPremiumˆalsoˆreimbursesˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆeachˆcalendarˆmonth,ˆinˆtheˆUSˆandˆabroad.ˆ##ˆSurchargesˆATMˆownersˆoutsideˆBrookLinkˆcanˆaddˆtheirˆownˆsurchargeˆonˆtopˆofˆourˆfee.ˆTheˆATMˆshowsˆitˆonˆscreenˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm.ˆ##ˆDailyˆlimitˆYouˆcanˆwithdrawˆupˆtoˆ$1,500ˆaˆdayˆonˆPremium.ˆ##ˆWhereˆfeesˆshowˆupˆAnyˆTallowbrookˆATMˆfeeˆappearsˆasˆitsˆownˆlineˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆrightˆafterˆtheˆwithdrawal,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆwhatˆyouˆpaidˆusˆandˆwhatˆtheˆATMˆownerˆcharged.ˆTheˆapp'sˆATMˆmapˆshowsˆtheˆnearestˆBrookLinkˆATMs.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
